LanguageData.LP_EndlessGrowth.label: endless growth
LanguageData.LP_EndlessGrowth.description: The carrier's body keeps growing: body size increases by 0.5 every year until it reaches 10. The larger the body, the higher the health, melee damage, carrying capacity and stomach capacity (giant-body rule), and the larger the pawn is drawn. At 10 the trait "behemoth" is gained: sleeps longer and eats more.
LanguageData.LP_EndlessGrowth.customEffectDescription: Body size +0.5 per year up to 10 (about 18 years; drawn at the square root of body size).
At 10 the trait "behemoth" is gained: rest fall rate ×150%, hunger rate ×200%.
Newly generated adults have already grown for 0.5-2 years (body size 1.25-2); babies and those who receive the gene later start from 1.
Health, melee and carrying rise with body size by the giant-body rule; stomach capacity × body size.
